svg.title: double-gauss, r2: hit distance by surface, ref and ref-warped
svg.desc: For each pair of the request, the largest distance between the two engines' hits on each surface (on each visit, for a trace of a folded path) over the rays ok in both answers, leaving out a visit either answer records no point for, as R2 measures hits.maxDistance. A distance of 0 is a ring on the axis, a surface where no ray is ok in both is a dash, and the line is the tolerance of the policy. The largest bar is 5.99e-7 mm, and the comparison records hits.maxDistance 5.99e-7 mm.
